doulas.name: Jennifer Vazquez — Pinellas Doula Services
doulas.quote: Hi! I'm Jennifer — a certified birth and postpartum doula and childbirth educator serving St. Petersburg and throughout Pinellas County

doulas.name: Tiffany Holmes — Quantum Motherhood
doulas.quote: Traditional Birth & Postpartum Doula, Hypnobirthing Childbirth Educator, Quantum Birthing Coach, Reiki Master, Pelvic Steaming Facilitator, and Intuitive Guide in St. Petersburg, FL

doulas.name: Madeline Ishmael
doulas.quote: My name is Madeline "Maddy" Ishmael and I am a certified birth doula through DONA since 2019, certified lactation consultant through Healthy Children Project and a prenatal yoga teacher.
doulas.note: Bornbir directory listing, based in St. Petersburg per page

doulas.name: Healthy Start Coalition of Pinellas — Doula Program
doulas.quote: Doula will be with the client during the labor and delivery... Must be a resident of Pinellas County

hospitals.name: Orlando Health Bayfront Hospital — Center for Women and Babies
hospitals.quote: Located on the third floor of Johns Hopkins All Children's Hospital, Orlando Health Bayfront Hospital Center for Women and Babies offers labor and delivery suites and maternity care.
hospitals.note: maternity wing beside JHU All Children's NICU

hospitals.name: HCA Florida St. Petersburg Hospital — Women's Center
hospitals.quote: In our secure labor and delivery unit, we offer private rooms where new families can bond together under the care of certified nurses and skilled physicians.
hospitals.note: 215-bed full-service; Leapfrog: patients may bring their own doulas; CNM deliveries; IBCLC lactation services

birthCenters.name: Breath of Life Women's Health & Birth Center
birthCenters.quote: Breath of Life Women's Health and Birth Center, located at 1900 East Bay Drive in Largo ... received its CABC accreditation status becoming Florida's only accredited birth center.
birthCenters.note: CABC-accredited; website lists St. Pete among served areas; CNM-led midwifery
